title: rosa canina var. reuteri
intro: Rosa canina var. reuteri, commonly known as the dwarf dog rose, is a type of rose species that belongs to the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is known to offer several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce oxidative stress, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina var. reuteri include its ability to act as a laxative, antidiarrheal, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a potential treatment for various gastrointestinal disorders and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and carotenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
